persona.archetype: a company clerk who outlasted her company
persona.backstory: Ninety years of Cinderwright road-tolls were entered in her hand. The company wound up four years ago. Nobody told the gear, and nobody told her.
persona.demeanor: unhurried; she has been at this desk longer than the party has been alive
persona.motivation: to collect what the road is owed and enter it in the ledger, because the ledger is the only thing left that says the road was built
persona.secret: The company owes her forty years of back pay. She is not collecting for them.
persona.speech_style: clerical and courteous, quotes the tariff by clause, never raises her voice, calls the party customers
